ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Curl.EXE Download
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious curl process start on Windows and outputs the requested document to a local file

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\curl\\\.exe$") OR process_product = "The\ curl\ executable") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%AppData\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%Public\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%Temp\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%tmp\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.gif$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.jpeg$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.jpg$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.png$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.temp$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.tmp$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.txt$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbe$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbs$"))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Git\\usr\\bin\\sh\.exe" AND process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Git\\mingw64\\bin\\curl\.exe" AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-silent\\ \\-\\-show\\-error\\ \\-\\-output\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*gfw\\-httpget\\-.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*AppData.*"))))
